name: clearjev-router
description: Advisory pre-prompt routing for Codex: Jev (TypeSafe System One) judges every prompt and recommends a real Codex model plus reasoning effort. Chat control via $clearjev; pre-routed CLI sessions via `clearjev run`.

interface.longDescription: ClearJev adds an advisory Jev judgment layer to Codex. A UserPromptSubmit hook classifies intent, complexity, risk and repository demand via the TypeSafe Jev API, then injects a concise recommendation (model, reasoning, planning, validation) as developer context. The hook cannot change the active session model: switch it natively with /model, or start a pre-routed CLI session with `clearjev run`. Manage routing from chat with the $clearjev skill (on/off/status/models/key). ClearJev is an independent open-source project, not affiliated with or endorsed by TypeSafe AI, Inc. Users must provide their own TypeSafe API key.
defaultPrompt: Show ClearJev status and available actions.
Turn ClearJev routing off for now.
List the models ClearJev can route to.
